scope: One prospective functional assay using supplied inverse correspondence and frozen pretrained teachers. Tests whether imposed geometry improves few-label target learning under these fixed settings, not spontaneous discovery of inverse algebra. A null result does not rule out other geometry weights, budgets or algorithms. Do not expand to a second pair before completing and reporting this pair.
uncertainty: Exact empirical percentile bootstrap: 6^6 target/support draws conditional on three frozen teachers, and 3^3 teacher-cluster draws. Shared test set is fixed. These descriptive intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted and do not establish population-level significance with three related teachers.
